dispatcher_comment: Tentative name. Large VM-like execution core reached from the JNI execute bridge. Receives a bytecode-buffer descriptor plus Java args object, then enters a large dispatch loop / jumptable-driven state machine. Crash PC 0x5d75c lands inside this function on an indexed signed-byte read (ldrsb x2, [x16, x11]). Treat this as VM interpreter/dispatcher territory until disproved.
notes: dispatch table is recovered manually from the ADR+LDRH+BR sequence near 0x53088
IDA did not expose the entry jump as a formal switch in this database
opcode mapping is first-pass static and maps to basic-block starts inside the dispatcher function
